note: [2026-10-04T23:00Z lane CI-AUTOMERGE] ROOT CAUSES (MEASURED, 116 open automation/* PRs): (1) commit-to-main cut its branch from the caller's checkout, so research runs dispatched on a session branch carried it (21 PRs failed pr-landing R5/R12); (2) stale-automation-sweep refreshed 0/115, because it graded each PR absent_on_main on its own .github/merge-slots claim and its refresh() wrote the retired session-board.json. Both are fixed in #16494 (hold; manager merge). MERGED: #16491 (20 stranded research results, 22:16Z). MERGED: #16497 (append-only data rows) and #16505 (3 hygiene fixes, the 13 package dispositions, the close lists). NOT YET OBSERVED: sweeper refresh>0 after #16494 (pipeline PI-20261004-UTBSCEQM-0001).
